messages:
jamie_support: ACME customer (acme-corp / project: alpha) says workspace is in read-only — can't deploy models or view billing. Reported at 08:12 UTC. Any RBAC changes recently? :confused:

 taylor_sre: I'm on it. Checking recent policy rollouts and rolesync. Give me 2 mins.

 alex_k: Heads up — I merged a rolesync mapping PR (https://git.internal/pr/3123) earlier that changed attribute mapping from `membership.role` -> `org.role` for legacy tenants.

 maria_ops: That PR also had a migration script. Did the migration job finish? schedule: `rolesync-migrate-v2` ran 08:05 UTC, exit 0 per CI logs.

 alex_k: Here's the quick diff from the sync output:
```
- role: project.developer
  perms: [model.read, model.deploy, billing.view]
+ role: project.developer
  perms: [model.read, billing.view]
```
Looks like `model.deploy` dropped because the attribute path changed and didn't match existing attrs for acme.

 taylor_sre: Confirming via audit: `rbacctl audit --user acme@acme.com --since 1h`
```
ACME: project.alpha: roles: project.viewer
Denied: model.deploy (policy mismatch)
```

 jamie_support: Customer blocked from deploying new models, also couldn't create invoices — they escalated to support. They're asking for ETA.

 alex_k: Temporary fix: grant `model.deploy` to the team role while we patch sync. Command:
```
rbacctl grant --role project.developer --perm model.deploy --scope project.alpha --reason "hotfix for rolesync mismatch"
```
I'll run this now.

 taylor_sre: After grant, confirm deploy and billing UI access.

 jamie_support: Confirmed with customer — deploy button works and billing page loads. Access restored :white_check_mark:

 maria_ops: Next steps: patch rolesync mapping to fallback to legacy `membership.role` when `org.role` absent; add unit test and a canary rollout. Also file a postmortem and customer communication.

 jamie_support: Filed INC-2026-042 in our tracker and sent customer note. CC'ing @product-security for review. :thumbsup:

 incidents-bot: Incident logged INC-2026-042 | severity: P2 | assigned: alex_k, taylor_sre

 alex_k: I'll open the rollback PR and the patch. ETA for patch: 2 hours. Will follow up once merged.

 jamie_support: Thanks everyone — closing thread after patch verification.
